value.rationale: Variance finiteness is essential to finite-variance Monte Carlo error calibration. For exactly the original estimator and smooth Riccati solution there is a strict interval of valid expectation but infinite variance even under optimal constant clock selection; the exact pole and unique optimal clock quantify the cost/accuracy limitation. This is more than a restatement of the ODE solution or a routine variance calculation.
